note: Pimecrolimus is exclusively available as a topical cream formulation (Elidel 1%) in the United States. It is not manufactured as an oral tablet or capsule in any US-approved formulation. The drug is indicated for short-term and intermittent long-term treatment of mild to moderate atopic dermatitis in non-immunocompromised patients aged 2 years and older. There are no pill variants with imprints, shapes, or scored characteristics to report. Pimecrolimus is not available in oral dosage forms.
